title: Platelet-Rich Protein and the Endometrium
brief_summary: Platelet-rich plasma (PRP) may promote the endometrial growth and improve pregnancy outcome of patients with thin endometrium undergoing ART treatments.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Women undergoing a frozen thawed embryo transfer cycle with poor endometrial response to estrogen (\< 7 mm) after at least two standard preparation protocols, of which one was canceled due to thin endometrium

Exclusion Criteria:

* none
